title: Fireside Chat: The UK Critical Minerals Strategy
gist: Member-only listing for a 16-minute Benchmark Summit 2026 London fireside chat on the UK Critical Minerals Strategy between Oliver Richards, the UK government's Head of Critical Minerals and Mining, and Benchmark's Director of Indexing & Derivatives Daniel Fletcher-Manuel. No policy details are disclosed.

insights.claim: Oliver Richards, Head of Critical Minerals and Mining at the UK Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade, presented the UK Critical Minerals Strategy in a 16:21 fireside chat at Benchmark Summit 2026 London.
insights.speaker: Oliver Richards , Head of Critical Minerals and Mining , UK Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade;  Dan
insights.so_what: UK government officials are actively courting the critical-minerals industry; watch for UK policy support measures.
